scenes.label: KYOTO KISSATEN
scenes.head: 3 old coffee houses in Kyoto
scenes.body: Slow coffee, wood and brick, no rush.

scenes.label: 01  SMART COFFEE
scenes.head: Hotcakes since 1932
scenes.body: On Teramachi, near Sanjo. Weekends mean a line.

scenes.label: 02  ROKUYOSHA
scenes.head: Coffee and a homemade donut, downstairs
scenes.body: Kawaramachi-Sanjo. The basement is closed on Wednesdays.

scenes.label: 03  FRANCOIS
scenes.head: Open since 1934. A national cultural property.
scenes.body: Near Shijo, by the Takase River.
